teaser.en: Fresh twigs travel by lorry from the highlands to coast towns every day, to be chewed as a stimulant.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vibichi husafirishwa kwa malori kila siku kutoka nyanda za juu hadi miji ya pwani, ili kutafunwa kama kichangamshi.
teaser.dg: Chila siku maphungo dza garivyo nkutsukulwa kpwa malori kula tsi za dzulu za bara hadi midzi ya pwani, ili gaafunwe dza chitu cha kumpha mutu nguvu.

summary.en: Miraa, khat, is a shrub whose fresh leaves and shoots are chewed as a stimulant. It is grown inland and brought to the coast as a trade crop.
summary.sw: Miraa ni kichaka ambacho majani na machipukizi yake mabichi hutafunwa kama kichangamshi. Hulimwa bara na kuletwa pwani kama zao la biashara.
summary.dg: *Miraa*, *khat*, ni chitsaka ambacho makodzage na maphungoge dza garivyo nkuafunwa dza chitu cha kumpha mutu nguvu. Nkuphandwa bara na kurehwa pwani dza mmea wa biashara.

about.en: *Miraa* is an evergreen shrub or small tree with glossy, toothed leaves, often tinged red, on reddish young stems. The flowers are tiny and whitish. What matters to people is the tender young shoots and leaves, which are cut and sold in bundles while still fresh.
about.sw: *Miraa* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye meno pembeni, mara nyingi yenye rangi ya wekundu, juu ya mashina machanga mekundu-mekundu. Maua ni madogo sana na meupe-meupe. Kinachowajali watu ni machipukizi machanga laini na majani, ambayo hukatwa na kuuzwa kwa mafungu yangali mabichi.
about.dg: *Miraa* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala, gana meno kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji gana kundu chidide, dzulu ya milita miphya ya kundu chidide. Maruwa ni madide sana na mereru chidide. Chitu chenye samani kpwa atu ni maphungo maphya laini na makodza, ambago nkukatwa na kuguzwa kpwa mabunda wakati bado ni dza garivyo.

where.en: Khat is not a plant of the coastal bush. In Kenya it is grown mainly in the highlands east of Mount Kenya, especially around Meru, and it is carried to markets across the country, including the towns of the south coast.
where.sw: Miraa si mmea wa vichaka vya pwani. Nchini Kenya hulimwa hasa katika nyanda za juu mashariki mwa Mlima Kenya, hasa karibu na Meru, na husafirishwa hadi masoko kote nchini, ikiwemo miji ya pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Miraa* si mmea wa weruni wa pwani. Kenya nkuphandwa sana tsi za dzulu za mashariki ya Mount Kenya, hasa phephi na Meru, na nkutsukulwa hadi masoko ga kosi tsi, phamwenga na midzi ya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fresh leaves and shoots are chewed for their stimulant effect, often in long social sessions. The active substances fade within a day or two of cutting, so the trade depends on fast transport. Heavy use is linked to health and social problems, and khat is banned in a number of countries.
uses.sw: Majani na machipukizi mabichi hutafunwa kwa sababu ya athari yake ya kuchangamsha, mara nyingi katika vikao virefu vya kijamii. Viambato vyake hai hupotea ndani ya siku moja au mbili baada ya kukatwa, kwa hiyo biashara yake hutegemea usafiri wa haraka. Matumizi ya kupita kiasi yanahusishwa na matatizo ya kiafya na kijamii, na miraa imepigwa marufuku katika nchi kadhaa.
uses.dg: Makodza na maphungo dza garivyo nkuafunwa kpwa sababu ganampha mutu nguvu, mara nyinji kpwa saa nyinji atu achisagala phamwenga. Kemikali zinazohenda kazi ndani ya makodza nkumala nguvu kahi ya siku mwenga au mbiri bada ya kukatwa, kpwa hivyo biashara ya *miraa* inakuluphira kuhalwa haraka. Kuhumira sana nkulungana na shida za uzima na shida za atu phamwenga, na *miraa* ikazuwiywa kpwa shariya kpwenye tsi nyinji.

names.en: Pakia lists *miraa*, the same word as in Swahili, with the English names khat and Abyssinian tea. The Mgombato dictionary has a separate entry, *mvumo*, for khat, with the Swahili glosses *miraa* and *mwandama*. In Pakia's list, *mvumo* is the name of the borassus palm.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *miraa*, neno lile lile kama la Kiswahili, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *khat* na *Abyssinian tea*. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina kidahizo tofauti, *mvumo*, kwa miraa, ikitoa maelezo ya Kiswahili *miraa* na *mwandama*. Katika orodha ya Pakia, *mvumo* ni jina la mvumo (borassus palm).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *miraa*, neno hiro hiro dza ra Chiswahili, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza *khat* na *Abyssinian tea*. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina neno ranjina, *mvumo*, ra *khat*, renye madzina ga Chiswahili *miraa* na *mwandama*. Kpwenye orodha ya Pakia, *mvumo* ni dzina ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi unaoihwa *borassus palm*.

reason.sw: Mtumbaku, zao jingine la kichangamshi katika maisha ya kila siku
